#Exercise 1:
```{r}
# Loading TSA library
library(TSA)
# Loading larain data
data(larain)
```

```{r}
# Scatterplot of Current Year's rainfall vs Previous Year's rainfall
plot(larain[-1], larain[-2], xlab="Current Year's rainfall", ylab="Previous Year's rainfall")
```

#Exercise 2
```{r}
n <- 1000 # sample size

# computing and plotting {Sn} 
for (i in 1:10){
  # generating {Xk}
  Xks = 2 * rbinom(n, 1, 0.5) - 1
  
  # computing {Sn}
  Sns <- cumsum(Xks)

  # plotting {Sn}
  plot(1:n, Sns, type="l", xlab="n", ylab="Sn")
}
```
